summary: Ran deployment-change focused pytest (12 cases) + full Playwright UI smoke on the Vercel/Railway CRM Maiharta build. Backend health, root API, CORS preflight (echoes Origin + credentials:true), all 5 seed roles login, /api/auth/me Bearer flow, logout-invalidates-token, and full frontend flow (admin login → dashboard KPIs → sidebar-logo /assets/logo-mark.webp → no toggle-theme → light body bg rgb(243,245,250) → localStorage.maiharta_token persists across reload → nav /projects /clients /finance /tickets /users /settings without console errors → logout clears token & returns to /login) all PASS. Login page has correct data-testids (login-brand-mark, login-copyright '© 2026 CRM Maiharta', login-credit-link -> https://www.maiharta.com), no data-testid='footer', no CRAFTED/Built-for text. Role gating verified: client has no Keuangan menu; accounting has no Tiket Client menu. Existing regression suite test_api_regression.py NOT re-run because its document upload/workflow tests assert 200 responses that will now fail against the intentionally-503 Cloudinary path — flagged for main agent. ONE bug found: backend raises HTTPException(502) on Cloudinary failure but review request (and Cloudflare ingress behavior) requires 503 so client sees the Indonesian JSON message instead of a Cloudflare HTML error page.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 502 when Cloudinary env is not configured (backend/projects.py line 162 & 177). The Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress converts 502 into an HTML error page, so the client never receives the intended Indonesian JSON message. Change status_code to 503 (Service Unavailable) as requested. Same fix needed for download_document line 177.

action_items: In /app/backend/projects.py replace HTTPException(502,'Penyimpanan dokumen (Cloudinary) belum dapat dihubungi...') with HTTPException(503, ...) on lines 162 and 177 so the ingress does not swallow the response body.

Update /app/backend/tests/test_api_regression.py: document upload tests (test_document_upload_download_and_validation and test_workflow_development_requires_four_documents) will fail against the current Cloudinary-less deployment because they assume 200 uploads — either mark them skip when CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME is empty, or update expectations to 503.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/projects.py line 162 & 177 use 502 for a dependency-configuration failure — 503 Service Unavailable is the correct semantic and also avoids Cloudflare converting the response to HTML.
test_api_regression.py has tight coupling with Cloudinary being configured; consider a pytest marker/skip based on env presence of CLOUDINARY_* so the suite remains green in the preview environment.
seed_data_creation: None — only login was performed; no CRUD writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent flips 502→503 in projects.py, rerun `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_deployment_changes.py::test_document_upload_returns_503_when_cloudinary_missing` to confirm. Full regression at /app/backend/tests/test_api_regression.py was intentionally not rerun since its upload/workflow tests assume Cloudinary is configured (they will 502/503 fail). UI is fully working; no rework needed on frontend.
rca of the issue: The Kubernetes ingress + Cloudflare in front of the preview URL treat backend 502 responses as an upstream failure and return their own HTML error page (observed as an HTML body starting with <!DOCTYPE html> / 'oldie' IE conditional-comment template), which strips the JSON detail message the FastAPI handler set. HTTP 503 is not intercepted, so returning 503 preserves the intended JSON `{detail: 'Penyimpanan dokumen (Cloudinary) belum dapat dihubungi...'}` to the client. Reproduction: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -F kind=Kontrak -F visibility=Internal -F file=@tiny.txt <URL>/api/projects/project-1/documents` returns 502 + Cloudflare HTML. Fix: change status codes 502→503 in backend/projects.py lines 162 and 177.
